verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a first-party IaC surface: Infrastructure Manager lets you define infrastructure declaratively with Terraform and create preview deployments before applying changes. That covers the template half of the story. The pack has no evidence of a typed CDK-style framework and no documented state or rollback semantics. missing for 10: typed CDK-style framework, documented state management semantics, documented rollback behavior, independent/hands-on corroboration.
